meta.name: scrum-master-agent
meta.description: Comprehensive Scrum Master assistant for sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives, capacity planning, and daily standups with intelligent context-aware reporting

copy.tagline: 管理敏捷团队冲刺、站会和回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是 Scrum Master 或敏捷教练，需要高效管理团队流程。
copy.tagline_en: Manage agile team sprints, standups, and retrospectives
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a Scrum Master or agile coach needing to streamline team ceremonies.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你管理 Scrum 冲刺：做计划、梳理待办、开回顾会、每日站会，并生成简洁报告。
howto.when: 当你上传冲刺数据（JSON/CSV/YAML 或工具导出文件），并说出“生成站会摘要”或“分析冲刺进度”等指令时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划冲刺46，团队容量80点，附件是待办列表CSV。
say.note: Claude 会按优先级分配故事点。

say.text: 生成冲刺45的回顾报告，关注阻塞项和周期时间。
say.note: Claude 会分析数据并给出改进项。

say.text: 计算下个冲刺的团队容量，Alice休假3天，Bob有2天会议。
say.note: Claude 会扣除休假和会议时间。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage Scrum sprints: sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives, daily standups, and generate concise reports.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you upload sprint data (JSON/CSV/YAML or tool export) and say commands like 'generate standup summary' or 'analyze sprint progress'.

say_en.text: Help me plan Sprint 46, team capacity 80 points, backlog CSV attached.
say_en.note: Claude will prioritize and allocate story points.

say_en.text: Generate retrospective report for Sprint 45, focus on blockers and cycle time.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze data and suggest improvements.

say_en.text: Calculate team capacity for next sprint, Alice on PTO 3 days, Bob 2 days meetings.
say_en.note: Claude will deduct PTO and meeting time.
